integrity.claim_scope: The proof determines the complete projective k-point stabilizer through the normalization linear series and proves simple transitivity on the smooth locus.
integrity.literature_boundary: The source supplies the quartic family, singularity and tangent geometry; the projective stabilizer computation is separated from those prior statements.
integrity.reproducibility: Exact symbolic polynomial identities are supplied in verification/verify.py; no numerical approximation or finite sample is used as an infinite-field proof.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the c=1 plane member over an algebraically closed field of characteristic 2.
The stabilizer is the group of k-points in PGL_3(k); no assertion is made about possible nonreduced infinitesimal structure of the stabilizer scheme.
Abstract automorphisms of the singular curve that do not extend to the plane are outside the claim.
title: Additive projective symmetry of the standard type-(4) characteristic-two quartic
